topics.title: Introducing taking inputs - fmt.scan()
topics.description: Study concepts and solve targeted engineering problems for Introducing taking inputs - fmt.scan().

pages.title: Multiple Choice Question
pages.content:
What will be the output of this code, if the user enters Chef?

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var s string
	fmt.Scan(&s)
	fmt.Println("Your name is: ", s)
}


```

callout.title: Key takeaway
callout.text: Introducing taking inputs - fmt.scan(): focus on the Go syntax and runtime behavior demonstrated in this lesson.

codeCard.code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    var a, b int
    fmt.Scan(&a, &b)
    fmt.Println(a + b)
}

pages.title: Multiple Choice Question
pages.content:
What will be the output of this code, if the a = 5 and b = 9 based on user input?

```go
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
	var a, b int
	fmt.Scan(&a, &b)
	fmt.Print(a)
        fmt.Print(b)
        fmt.Print(a+b)
}


```

pages.title: Multiple Choice Question
pages.content:
What will be the output of this code, if the user enters 5 and 9?

```go
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
	var a, b int
	fmt.Scan(&a, &b)
	c := a + 2
	d := c + b
	fmt.Println(d)
}


```
